name: Smarter attention to save memory
gist: These papers speed up the attention mechanism—a core bottleneck in transformers—by using sparse patterns, linear tricks, or clever reuse of cached values instead of computing everything.
explain: Attention is the mechanism that lets a neural network decide which parts of the input to focus on. In a language model, it works like this: for each word in a document, the model looks at every other word and computes a relevance score. Those scores then weight which information gets passed forward. It lets the network connect ideas across long distances, but it is also expensive: if a document has 1,000 words, you are doing 1 million comparisons (1,000 times 1,000). For a 100,000-word document, that is 10 billion comparisons. The memory needed to store all those scores explodes.

Researchers noticed that most of those scores are actually tiny — the model cares about only a small subset of other words for any given position. So one direction is sparse attention: instead of looking at all words, look at only nearby words, or only those with high scores. Another direction is linear approximation — use math tricks to compute an approximate answer without storing all the scores. A third is to reuse computed values: if you have already computed the score between word A and word B earlier in the network, do you have to recompute it? These papers measure how much you can approximate or skip without the model losing its ability to understand.

The tradeoff is accuracy versus speed. Sparse attention loses some information because it does not see all connections. Linear attention gives an approximation that is not perfect but is much faster because it skips the expensive matrix multiplications — it trades a small loss in accuracy for much smaller compute time. Researchers experiment with which parts of the network can afford to be approximate (middle layers might not need full attention) and which need full precision (early layers learning basic patterns). The goal is to find the sweet spot where the model stays smart but memory and compute stay manageable.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need for KV Cache in Diffusion LLMs
papers.contribution: Elastic-Cache achieves 8.7x speedup on GSM8K (256 tokens), 45.1x on longer sequences, and 4.8x on HumanEval with negligible generation quality loss.

papers.title: DASH: Deterministic Attention Scheduling for High-throughput Reproducible LLM Training
papers.contribution: Improves attention backward pass throughput by up to 1.28× compared to baseline, significantly advancing reproducible LLM training efficiency while maintaining determinism.

papers.title: Forge: Compiling a Unified Abstraction into Scalable Kernels for Linear Attention
papers.contribution: Forge enables 1.01x-4.9x performance improvements on diverse linear attention variants and scales to 16 million tokens on 128 GPUs with up to 7.2x speedup over prior distributed baselines.

papers.title: LaplacianFormer:Rethinking Linear Attention with Laplacian Kernel
papers.contribution: LaplacianFormer achieves strong performance-efficiency trade-offs on ImageNet while improving attention expressiveness compared to existing linear attention variants.

papers.title: LookaheadKV: Fast and Accurate KV Cache Eviction by Glimpsing into the Future without Generation
papers.contribution: Outperforms recent baselines by 25% on long-context tasks while reducing eviction cost by up to 14.5×, achieving significantly faster time-to-first-token.

papers.title: Memory Caching: RNNs with Growing Memory
papers.contribution: Competitive performance with Transformers on in-context recall tasks; closes the gap on long-context understanding while maintaining subquadratic complexity.

papers.title: Multi-Head Low-Rank Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art perplexity while delivering 2.8x decoding speedup over MLA under tensor parallelism.

papers.title: Neural Dynamics Self-Attention for Spiking Transformers
papers.contribution: Lowers memory overhead while delivering significant performance improvements for energy-efficient vision Transformers.

papers.title: RACE Attention: A Strictly Linear-Time Attention for Long-Sequence Training
papers.contribution: Achieves strictly linear time in sequence length and embedding size, processing up to 12M tokens on GPU and 75M on CPU while matching or outperforming strong baselines.

papers.title: Tactic: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Clustering and Distribution Fitting for Long-Context LLMs
papers.contribution: Tactic outperforms existing sparse attention algorithms with 5.14× decode attention speedup, achieving 1.51× end-to-end inference speedup on long-context tasks.

papers.title: Understanding the Dynamics of Forgetting and Generalization in Continual Learning via the Neural Tangent Kernel
papers.contribution: Forge enables 1.01x-4.9x performance improvements on diverse linear attention variants and scales to 16 million tokens on 128 GPUs with up to 7.2x speedup over prior distributed baselines.

papers.title: A Unified Sparse Attention via Multi-Granularity Compression
papers.contribution: UniSparse achieves 99% of full-attention accuracy with up to 2.61× faster attention computation than FlashAttention across multiple modalities and tasks including synthetic and real-world applications.

papers.title: ASTRAEA: A Token-wise Acceleration Framework for Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Astraea achieves up to 2.4x single-GPU speedup and 13.2x speedup on 8 GPUs with less than 0.5% VBench quality loss, demonstrating practical scalability with great GPU parallelism.

papers.title: AdaSplash-2: Faster Differentiable Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Matches or improves per-step training time relative to FlashAttention-2 at moderate-to-high block sparsity, with gains in long-context settings.

papers.title: BeaconKV: Key-Value Cache Compression Guided by Beacon Queries for Efficient Large Reasoning Model Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 5.8× memory reduction while nearly preserving full cache accuracy and improving throughput over 4.3×.

papers.title: Budget-Constrained Step-Level Diffusion Caching
papers.contribution: On FLUX.1-dev and Wan2.1, achieves better generation quality than heuristic baselines under tight compute budgets.

papers.title: Cache What Lasts: Token Retention for Memory-Bounded KV Cache in LLMs
papers.contribution: TRIM-KV outperforms baselines especially in low-memory regimes and can surpass full-cache models via regularization.

papers.title: DSA: Efficient Inference For Video Generation Models via Distributed Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: On 8 GPUs, DSA achieves 1.43x speedup over existing distributed methods and 10.79x faster than single-GPU inference.

papers.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieve 27.85× speedup in self-attention and 9.17× end-to-end speedup at 32k sequence length with negligible accuracy loss.

papers.title: Dynamic Linear Attention
papers.contribution: DLA demonstrates superiority over state-of-the-art on 10 datasets across three evaluation aspects for long-context modeling.

papers.title: EchoAttention: Exploiting Token-Pair Redundancy and Frame-Block Similarity for Efficient Video Generation
papers.contribution: Consistently improve speed-quality frontier across video DiTs, reducing end-to-end latency up to 2.42x with minimal quality loss through joint token-pair and frame-block redundancy exploitation.

papers.title: Entropy-Aware Dynamic KV Cache Sparsification for Autoregressive Image Generation and Editing
papers.contribution: Significantly improves inference efficiency while maintaining or improving generation and editing quality across four representative AR models on multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: EpiCache: Episodic KV Cache Management for Long-Term Conversation on Resource-Constrained Environments
papers.contribution: Improves accuracy up to 30% with 4-6× compression; reduces latency and peak memory by 2.4× and 3.7×; spans three LongConvQA benchmarks.

papers.title: EventFlash: Towards Efficient MLLMs for Event-Based Vision
papers.contribution: EventFlash achieves 12.4x throughput improvement while maintaining comparable performance and supports long-range event stream processing with up to 1,000 bins.

papers.title: FAST-AR: Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion and World Models with Temporal Cache Compression and Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 5-10× end-to-end speedups while preserving visual quality and maintaining stable throughput.

papers.title: FSA: An Alternative Efficient Implementation of Native Sparse Attention Kernel
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3.5x kernel-level latency reduction and up to 1.25x end-to-end training speedup on state-of-the-art LLMs.

papers.title: Fast KV Compaction via Attention Matching
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 50× compaction in seconds on some datasets with little quality loss, significantly pushing the Pareto frontier of compaction time versus quality.

papers.title: HARD-KV: Head-Adaptive Regularization for Decoding-time KV Compression
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2× throughput improvement over static baselines on math-reasoning benchmarks (AIME, U-Math) while maintaining high-fidelity 10k+ token generation.

papers.title: HilbertA: Hilbert-Curve–Aligned Sparse Attention for 2D Structured Data
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 4.16× attention acceleration and 1.44× end-to-end speedup on Flux.1-dev and up to 2.30× attention acceleration with 1.57× faster time-to-first-token on Qwen3-VL-8B.

papers.title: InfoFlow KV: Information-Flow-Aware KV Recomputation for Long Context
papers.contribution: The method demonstrates consistent gains over prior heuristic methods under comparable latency on LLM and vision-language benchmarks.

papers.title: Interleaved Selective State Space Models for Efficient WiFi-Based 3D Multi-Person Pose Estimation
papers.contribution: Achieves 16-27% MPJPE reduction while using only 4.4% of baseline parameters (2.14M vs 48.2M), providing superior efficiency-accuracy trade-offs for edge deployment.

papers.title: KernelFoundry: Hardware-Aware Evolutionary GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.contribution: KernelFoundry consistently outperforms baselines, achieving an average speedup of 2.3 on KernelBench for SYCL kernels.

papers.title: LIVEditor-14B: Lightning Unified Video Editing via In-Context Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: LIVEditor-14B achieves ~60% reduction in latency while surpassing state-of-the-art methods across EditVerseBench, IVE-Bench, and VIE-Bench with experimentally lossless acceleration.

papers.title: LazyAttention: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Deferred Positional Encoding
papers.contribution: Reduces time-to-first-token by 1.37x and increases throughput by 1.40x compared to Block-Attention under skewed distributions while maintaining quality.

papers.title: Light Forcing: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves 84.5 VBench score with 1.2–1.3× end-to-end speedup and combines with other solutions for 2.0–3.0× speedup across GPUs including 27.4 FPS on RTX 5090.

papers.title: Linearizing Vision Transformer with Test-Time Training
papers.contribution: Linearizes Stable Diffusion 3.5 with comparable quality at 1.32× and 1.47× speedup at 1K and 2K resolutions using only 1 hour fine-tuning on 4 H20 GPUs.

papers.title: LoSA: Locality Aware Sparse Attention in Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: Up to 4.14× speedup over dense attention while preserving near-dense accuracy and achieving 5% improvement on reasoning benchmarks.

papers.title: Long-Context Modeling with Dynamic Hierarchical Sparse Attention for Memory-Constrained LLM Inference
papers.contribution: The method maintains near-dense accuracy at high sparsity, achieving 12-20% relative gains over block sparse attention and 10x prefill speedup at 128K context.

papers.title: MDN: Parallelizing Stepwise Momentum for Delta Linear Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves comparable training throughput with consistent performance improvements over Transformers and Mamba2 on 400M-1.3B models.

papers.title: ManifoldKV: Training-Free KV Cache Compression via Euclidean Outlier Detection
papers.contribution: Achieves 95.7% accuracy at 4K-16K with 20% compression and 92.4% on multi-key retrieval, decisively outperforming cosine-based approaches.

papers.title: Mixing Importance with Diversity: Joint Optimization for KV Cache Compression in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Consistently enhances existing methods across LVLMs with 5.1% average improvement under extreme compression and 8.0-9.0% gains on GUI grounding tasks.

papers.title: Mixture of Distributions Matters: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Efficient Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.contribution: Achieves consistent acceleration and quality improvements across benchmarks and architectures for efficient high-quality video generation without sampling overhead.

papers.title: Multipole Semantic Attention: A Fast Approximation of Softmax Attention for Pretraining
papers.contribution: MuSe accelerates 64k-context pretraining by 36% while matching baseline loss, compatible with Llama 3.1-8B and 3.2-1B without retraining.

papers.title: Neural Attention Search Linear: Towards Adaptive Token-Level Hybrid Attention Models
papers.contribution: NAtS-L provides a strong yet efficient token-level hybrid architecture that improves upon interleaved approaches.

papers.title: Norm$\times$Direction: Restoring the Missing Query Norm in Vision Linear Attention
papers.contribution: NaLaFormer achieves up to 7.5% accuracy gain on ImageNet-1K and 4.7% mIoU on ADE20K over baselines; reduces peak memory by 92.3% on token-intensive tasks.

papers.title: On Efficient Scaling of GNNs via IO-Aware Layers Implementations
papers.contribution: Fused attention kernels achieve up to 3.9× speedup for Graph Transformer with median 1.6×, and up to 8.5× for GATv2 with 76× peak memory reduction, validated across diverse graph sizes.

papers.title: Out of the Memory Barrier: A Highly Memory-Efficient Training System for LLMs with Million-Token Contexts
papers.contribution: Enables training Qwen2.5-7B with 4M-token context on single H200 GPU; adds only 10MB memory per 10K additional tokens.

papers.title: PLASH: Provably Linear-Time Attention with Selective Higher-Order Feature Sketching
papers.contribution: PLASH achieves linear cost in keys with competitive accuracy and favorable scaling, proven with sketch-error bounds and per-input certificates.

papers.title: PLoRA: Efficient Concurrent LoRA Training for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: PLoRA improves training throughput by up to 12.8x and reduces overall fine-tuning makespan by up to 7.52x compared to existing approaches.

papers.title: Predicting Future Utility: Global Combinatorial Optimization for Task-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction
papers.contribution: Reduces KV cache by 80% with minimal performance degradation on LongBench and RULER benchmarks while decreasing latency and GPU memory.

papers.title: Prism: Spectral-Aware Block-Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Maintains accuracy parity with full attention while delivering up to 5.1× speedup through training-free spectral estimation.

papers.title: QiMeng-PerceptOS: Semantic-Aware Kernel Optimization for OS-Intensive Workloads via Hardware-Software Alignment
papers.contribution: Achieves 296.6% of default Redis throughput and surpasses SOTA by 32.6% within 15 iterations, establishing perception-driven closed-loop for automated system optimization.

papers.title: Reconstructing KV Caches with Cross-Layer Fusion for Enhanced Transformers
papers.contribution: FusedKV reduces cache memory by 50% while achieving lower validation perplexity than standard Transformer decoders across LLMs ranging from 332M to 4B parameters.

papers.title: Retrospective Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Generation
papers.contribution: RetroAttention increases effective KV exposure by up to 1.6x and accuracy by up to 21.9% compared to state-of-the-art KV compression methods on long-generation benchmarks.

papers.title: SLA: Beyond Sparsity in Diffusion Transformers via Fine-Tunable Sparse–Linear Attention
papers.contribution: SLA achieves 20x reduction in attention computation and 95% reduction in attention computational cost with 13.7x attention speedup and 2.2x end-to-end video generation speedup without quality degradation.

papers.title: SSA: Sparse Sparse Attention by Aligning Full and Sparse Attention Outputs in Feature Space
papers.contribution: Achieve state-of-the-art performance under both inference modes with smooth adaptation to varying sparsity budgets and superior long-context capabilities.

papers.title: STARK: Strategic Team of Agents for Refining Kernels
papers.contribution: Produces correct solutions where baselines fail and achieves up to 16X faster runtime performance on KernelBench.

papers.title: Scaling Linear Attention with Sparse State Expansion
papers.contribution: After RL training, a 2B SSE-H model achieves state-of-the-art mathematical reasoning performance among small reasoning models, scoring 64.5 on AIME24.

papers.title: Scout Before You Attend: Sketch-and-Walk Sparse Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Maintains near-lossless accuracy at 20% attention density with up to 4.7x end-to-end attention speedup over FlashAttention-2, sometimes outperforming dense attention while uniformly applying to both prefill and decode.

papers.title: Semantic Integrity Matters: Benchmarking and Preserving High-Density Reasoning in KV Cache Compression
papers.contribution: Achieves 9-18% accuracy improvements on long-context generation tasks while delivering 11% latency reduction compared to full cache inference.

papers.title: SparseD: Sparse Attention for Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: SparseD reduces latency while handling head-specific patterns without recomputing sparse patterns at each denoising step, demonstrating that careful sparse attention design for DLMs differs fundamentally from autoregressive approaches.

papers.title: SpikeNet: Sparse Spike-Driven Mask Vector Transformer for Energy-Efficient and Stable Spiking Point Cloud Processing
papers.contribution: SpikeNet achieves state-of-the-art performance comparable to ANN-based methods while optimizing both performance and energy efficiency on shape classification and segmentation.

papers.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves superior accuracy with reduced computation and pre-filling latency through information-flow-aligned sparsity.

papers.title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 1.5x decode-step attention-kernel speedup and 1.25x end-to-end decode-latency speedup on Llama-3.1-8B with 32k-token contexts while matching baseline accuracy.

papers.title: TGV-KV: Text-Grounded KV Eviction for Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Preserves 99.2% full-KV accuracy on VizWiz-VQA with LLaVA-NeXT while boosting end-to-end throughput by 52.6% at 5% retention budget.

papers.title: Test-Time Training with KV Binding Is Secretly Linear Attention
papers.contribution: Reframes TTT as learned linear attention rather than test-time memorization, enabling principled architectural simplifications and fully parallel formulations.

papers.title: Token Sparse Attention: Efficient Long-Context Inference with Interleaved Token Selection
papers.contribution: Token Sparse Attention achieves up to 3.23× attention speedup at 128K context with less than 1% accuracy degradation, compatible with Flash Attention and existing sparse kernels.

papers.title: Training-Free Hashing-Based Attention via Binary Principal Components
papers.contribution: BinaryPC preserves accuracy relative to full attention while achieving 3.56× end-to-end decoding throughput improvement over FlashAttention on modern GPUs.

papers.title: Tucker Attention: A generalization of approximate attention mechanisms
papers.contribution: Tucker Attention requires an order of magnitude fewer parameters than GQA and MLA for comparable performance on LLMs and ViTs while encompassing them as special cases.

papers.title: TyphoonMLA: A Mixed Naive-Absorb MLA Kernel For Shared Prefix
papers.contribution: Improves attention throughput by up to 3x and 3.24x on NPU/GPUs; boosts end-to-end throughput by 1.48x tokens/second with only 3% HBM overhead.

papers.title: Vegas: Self-Speculative Decoding with Verification-Guided Sparse Attention
papers.contribution: Achieve 1.25x-2.81x speedup over vLLM and 1.15x-1.29x speedup over state-of-the-art sparse-attention self-speculative methods by leveraging verification-guided KV selection.

papers.title: vAttention: Verified Sparse Attention via Sampling
papers.contribution: Improved sparse attention quality by ~4.5 percentage points and bridged the gap between full and sparse attention at 10x-20x sparsity.
